INSERT INTO bear_tasks (
            bear_id, job_id, sibling_order, title, body, completion_criteria,
            created_by_role, created_by_user_id
        )
        SELECT $1, $2, n - 1000, 'private filler ' || n, 'private body',
               '["done"]'::jsonb, 'pair', $3
        FROM generate_series(1, 510) AS n
